parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
request AS (
  SELECT
    data->>'eventId' AS event_id,
    btrim(data->>'name') AS full_name,
    lower(btrim(data->>'email')) AS email,
    data->>'ticket' AS ticket_text,
    COALESCE(data->>'consent', 'false') = 'true' AS consent
  FROM input
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO eventflow.registrations (event_id, full_name, email, qr_token, consent)
  SELECT r.event_id, r.full_name, r.email, r.ticket_text::uuid, r.consent
  FROM request r
  JOIN eventflow.events e ON e.event_id = r.event_id AND e.registration_open
  WHERE r.consent
    AND length(r.full_name) BETWEEN 2 AND 120
    AND length(r.email) BETWEEN 3 AND 254
    AND r.email ~* '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'
    AND r.ticket_text ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING qr_token
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM created) THEN 'registered'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eventflow.events e JOIN request r ON e.event_id = r.event_id) THEN 'unknown_event'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eventflow.events e JOIN request r ON e.event_id = r.event_id WHERE NOT e.registration_open) THEN 'event_closed'
    ELSE 'duplicate_or_invalid'
  END AS status,
  (SELECT qr_token::text FROM created LIMIT 1) AS ticket;
